ms.report:
We added to document 2 that the Monthly Reports will be sent in PDF format to the reviewers at each milestone delivery.
We added to document 3 that the prize conversion from reais to ADA will be carried out at the end of June, so the conversion rate to be considered will be the one at the end of June.
Regarding the prize amounts:
The prize distribution was defined with the aim of encouraging competitiveness and proportionally rewarding the impact and effort of the top positions. The first place receives a significantly higher amount because this position represents the best performance, ensuring a robust incentive for participants to dedicate themselves fully.
The difference in amounts follows a common model in competitions and prizes, where the first place receives greater recognition to reinforce the incentive and reward excellence. Additionally, this structure helps create a more competitive and attractive environment for participants.
The prize was structured to recognize the three most engaged participants, as the goal is to encourage active and continuous participation throughout the activities. However, we would like to clarify that all activities will only start after the registration period ends.
This way, no one will have an advantage for signing up earlier or later, ensuring a level playing field for everyone.
We have not yet started promoting the registrations because we are waiting for the approval of the documents and the proposed plan. We believe that a one-week promotion period will be sufficient to engage interested parties, using all our channels to ensure broad reach.
Regarding the registration deadline on March 15, we understand the concern but emphasize that all activities will only begin after the registration period ends, guaranteeing equal conditions for all participants.
We added to document 3 that, in case participants do not reach the minimum score, the prize amount will be used to hold an in-person event.
